intro: Real local help across Smith County, sourced from each organization's own published contact page. Texas also runs statewide help at 211texas.org — dial 2-1-1.
verified_note: Every listing below was taken from the organization's own website in September 2026. More entries are added as they are verified. If a number is wrong, telling us fixes it for every neighbor after you.

categories.title: Food

resources.name: East Texas Food Bank
resources.what: Regional food bank; Tyler Resource Center distribution. easttexasfoodbank.org

resources.name: The Salvation Army — Tyler Corps
resources.what: Food, utility, and other emergency help (call to confirm what is available). southernusa.salvationarmy.org/tyler

resources.name: Meals on Wheels East Texas
resources.what: Home-delivered meals and safety checks for seniors and adults with disabilities. mealsonwheelsetx.org

categories.also: SNAP (food stamps) applications: YourTexasBenefits.com or dial 2-1-1.

resources.name: Bethesda Health Clinic
resources.what: Medical, dental, and mental health care for uninsured, low-income adults and underserved children. bethesdaclinic.org

resources.name: Andrews Center Behavioral Healthcare — 24-hour crisis line
resources.what: The local mental health authority for Smith County: crisis, behavioral health, substance use, veterans services. Main line 903-597-1351. andrewscenter.com

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.what: National 24/7 crisis line — call or text.

resources.name: Family Crisis Center of East Texas
resources.what: 24/7 domestic violence hotline, emergency shelter, and advocacy. Text line 936-552-9256. familycrisiscenterofeasttexas.com

resources.name: Lone Star Legal Aid — Tyler Office
resources.what: Free civil legal aid. Toll-free 800-248-0048. lonestarlegal.org

resources.name: Area Agency on Aging of East Texas
resources.what: Information, benefits counseling, legal help, and caregiver support for people 60 and older. Also 903-984-8641. easttexasaaa.org

resources.name: 2-1-1 Texas
resources.what: Help finding rent and utility assistance, food, housing, and more. Outside the region: 877-541-7905. 211texas.org
